description:
⚡ 2600W Peak Mid-Mounted Motor – The AMYET Electric Dirt Bike features a powerful 2600W peak mid-drive motor with 120Nm torque, reaching speeds up to 31 MPH. Accelerate from 0–20 MPH in just 1.5 seconds and conquer 30° hills with ease. Built for off-road adventures, mountain trails, sand, and daily commuting, this electric dirt bike for adults delivers exceptional power and control.
🔋 48V 20Ah Removable UL Battery – Ride up to 25 miles per charge with the removable 48V 20Ah lithium battery. Easily remove the battery by unlocking the seat for convenient indoor charging. The UL-certified battery with advanced BMS protection ensures safe charging, stable performance, longer battery life, and reliable power for every adventure.
🏔️ Premium Suspension & All-Terrain Tires – Designed for every terrain, this AMYET electric motorcycle features 14" front and 12" rear fat tires for excellent traction on dirt, gravel, sand, pavement, and trails. Combined with an inverted hydraulic front fork and nitrogen-filled rear suspension, it delivers superior shock absorption, stability, and riding comfort.
🛡️ Ride Safer & Smarter – Equipped with hydraulic disc brakes, reverse gear, a colorful LCD display, ergonomic shock-absorbing seat, bright LED headlight, and hazard warning lights. This electric dirt bike offers responsive braking, effortless parking, real-time riding information, and improved visibility for safer rides day or night.
🎁 Stylish Design & UL2849 certified – Featuring a sleek carbon fiber finish, the AMYET electric dirt bike for adults supports riders up to 330 lbs and fits heights from 5'4" to 6'5". Fully certified to UL2849 and UL2272 safety standards, the entire electrical system and lithium battery pack pass rigorous professional testing, effectively preventing overheating, short circuits and thermal runaway to deliver all-around reliable riding safety.
